title: Dynamic Multi-Step Decoding for Time-Series Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.34409v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time-series forecasting models typically use a fixed decoding strategy at inference time: either one-shot prediction of the full horizon or autoregressive rollout over atomic chunks. While one-shot decoding reduces error accumulation, it can discard useful sequential structure; conversely, autoregressive decoding preserves temporal dependencies but may compound errors. We argue that the optimal decoding strategy is not fixed across inputs, but should be selected adaptively for each forecasting instance. We propose a dynamic strategy selector that treats the forecast rollout schedule as an inference-time decision problem for frozen pretrained time-series foundation models. The selector is a learned network that ranks candidate rollout schedules using hidden states of the backbone, and is trained on historical windows of the evaluated tasks for each backbone. translated_title: 时间序列基础模型的动态多步解码
translated_abstract: 时间序列预测模型通常在推理时采用固定的解码策略：要么一次性预测整个预测区间，要么在原子块上进行自回归滚动预测。一次性解码虽然减少了误差累积，但可能丢弃有用的序列结构；相反，自回归解码保留了时间依赖性，但可能导致误差复合。我们认为最优的解码策略不应在所有输入上固定不变，而应为每个预测实例自适应地选择。我们提出了一种动态策略选择器，将预测的滚动调度视为冻结的预训练时间序列基础模型在推理时的决策问题。该选择器是一个通过学习得到的网络，利用骨干网络的隐藏状态对候选的滚动调度进行排序，并在每个骨干网络所评估任务的历史窗口上进行训练。为了使候选集在指数级庞大的预测区间空间中可处理……
tldr: 该论文提出一种动态策略选择器，为冻结的时间序列基础模型在每个预测实例上自适应地选择最优的滚动解码调度，从而在误差累积与时间依赖性保留之间取得平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dynamic strategy selector that adaptively chooses the optimal rollout decoding schedule for each forecasting instance of frozen time-series foundation models, balancing error accumulation against temporal dependency preservation.
